bio.text: Jeff Belle is the Republican candidate for California's 52nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to information submitted to Ballotpedia, Belle served in the U.S. Navy from 1978 to 1980 and graduated from Star Spencer High School.
The same submission lists a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma City University (2019), a graduate degree from the American Public University System (2021), and work as a consultant.
